I was unsure of what I would get when I purchased these shears. I most defiantly was not expecting such good quality! When I got this set, I was immediatly very impressed with the quality of shears in this set. The set came in a leather case with the texturing shears as well as the barbers shears. This makes it really handy to keep up with these items as they are easily lost. As a bonus, a leather cleaning cloth for the shears and good quality comb (great for parting the hair) was included. reviews.t: Spend a few extra bucks for better quality
reviews.x: Very cheap.  They broke the first time I used them and did not cut cleanly.

reviews.t: You were supposed to cut hair, not fold it.
reviews.x: Not sharp. You had one job scissors. You didn't do it.

reviews.t: Good quality at a great price
reviews.x: Awesome. Using these were great. Had to take the plastic ring as my finger and thumb are too big, but once out, they felt great. Very smooth operation and no pulling of hair when cutting or thinning. Nice holder to keep them safe when not in use.

reviews.t: Great set at a great price!
reviews.x: Nice quality scissors and thinning shears that are a nice weight.  Not like many of the scissors that have no substance to them. The case is nice and has a sturdy zipper.  The only thing flimsy is the comb, but it serves it's purpose.

The cutting shears were a little dull however the thinning shears were sharp and worked great. They arrived on time with a nice easy caring case but the comb was popping out. But over all a good purchase and well worth it.

reviews.t: Thumb Hole is Way Too Small
reviews.x: Case is great, scissors are sharp and seem to be of decent quality, but the major complaint I have with them is that the thumb hole is no bigger than the finger hole. I can't even get my thumb in it. I wish i would have looked closer at the photos because I would not have ordered them for that reason.  If you have a small thumb you should be fine. If not, I would not recommend these.

reviews.t: Sorry but these shears were not sharp at all. ...
reviews.x: Sorry but these shears were not sharp at all. The section of hair I went to cut with them folded. The thinning/texturizing shear had an inconsistent pattern with the teeth. For the price I thought about paying to have them sharpened but I'm returning them. I need to spend more to have a quality shear.

Used the scissors to trim the ends of my sister's long beautiful hair and they worked just fine. Really just bought these for the occasional trim and I think they will work well for that. Since I was feathering the ends (cutting vertically with lots of little snips) I wish the scissors were able to move a little more quickly, but overall I still think these are a great value product. Love the zip up case!

I haven't had this item for very long. But it meets my expectations. I purchased this mainly for the thinning shears, and I did need some new hair scissors. The case is perfectly sized to carry and store the scissors.The scissors themselves are sharp, and cut hair easily. I'll update in a few months with how the scissors have held up.

I've used these scissors a total of five times so far and I can safely say they are wonderful. Never will I buy from a department store or grocery store again. I've not used professional stuff of different brands, but these are pretty good and have not dulled at all. The case keeps them in good condition as well.

reviews.t: Very nice quality and at an unexpectedly low price
reviews.x: My barber uses 'thinning shears' because my hair is very thick and gets wavy in between cuts. He showed me what to do...so I bought this set.  Very nice quality and at an unexpectedly low price,

reviews.t: Scissors don't cut very fine hair very well
reviews.x: Scissors don't cut very fine hair very well. My wife actually got upset at me purchasing this as my hair wasn't cut, nor the my toy Aussie's hair.
The little blue plastic rings fall right out of the handles. Otherwise, this product is exactly as advertised.
For the price is an excellent set.  I am not an expert but the lady that cut my hair told me is very good!!!!

reviews.t: What a smooth awesome cut. will buy again
reviews.x: These are very sharp scissors,I used them and was very surprised.What a smooth awesome cut.will buy again!!
Fabulous kit.  I cut my own hair and my husband's hair.  These are well made.  Very pleased with product.
GR8 quality set! Easy to carry everywhere -- everything works very well, and I use it all the time!

reviews.t: The product I received looked like another one that was available with blue accents and ...
reviews.x: The product did not match the image for the item I purchased. I specifically chose this one because the image was all siver and had the screws inset. The product I received looked like another one that was available with blue accents and screws that were raised. This was a gift so I no longer have it but I was not happy the I did not receive the item as pictured.

Zipper on case fell off when I unzipped the black case for the 1rst time. Not happy about that. I hope someone reaches out to me to replace the case. Good starter scisso I only use them to cut hair extensions not for actual hair cuts. Good value. Cheap packaging.

I bought it for home use and i'm not at all a professional. However, I doubt this will be good enough for professional use. They are small and for thin fingers. For an occasional trim at home this seems to be a good choice.

reviews.t: Great hair cutting kit for amateurs
reviews.x: I bought this to do occasional touchups on my hair in between hair cuts. Scissors are very sharp and cut well and accurate. Love the case that holds everything together. Just what I was looking for.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the quality and value for the price, calling it excellent quality at a low cost.
Several reviewers report the scissors broke or were not sharp on first use, with hair folding instead of cutting.
Reviewers frequently mention the sharpness and smooth cutting performance, with no hair pulling.
The included case is commonly praised as nice and sturdy for storage.
Some reviewers complain the thumb hole is too small and the comb is flimsy or popping out.
